quote.text:
So I'm just really happy that at the end, I found my way and just played great.
我很高兴，最终找到了自己的办法，也打出了很好的表现。

And obviously it's been a really emotional and an amazing week for me that I learned a lot, you know,
这一周让我感慨万千，也非常美妙，我学到了很多。

to keep going forward step by step,
继续一步一步向前走，

playing on indoor courts, trying to gain more confidence playing on this surface.
在室内场上比赛，努力在这种场地上积累更多信心。

So I'm just really happy and looking forward for the rest of the season.
我很高兴，也期待赛季接下来的比赛。
